newsitem.title: UAE: Internet opportunities for air cargo industry.
newsitem.headline: Internet opportunities for air cargo industry.

text.p: Internet "offers an opportunity to fast forward" the air cargo industry into the new communications era, "and those who do not seize the initiative will become as extinct as dinosaurs," the president of the world's top air cargo association, Ram Menen said.

"If we had all foreseen the impact of the Net, we would have developed oour cargo community systems in a completely different way. These systems, many of them newly developed and comissioned, have suddenly become outdated," he added.
Menen was speaking at the start of the The International Air Cargo Association (TIACA) 18th conference starting here on Sunday.

"Even if you let your imagination run wild in assessing the future developments of communications technology, your images be found lacking. boundaries are being torn apart. Trade and business is now open territory," he said.
He also said he was concerned at the industry's inability to improve shipment times and the general picture of "an industry traveling ssluggishly in the slow lane."
He quoted from a recent report by Unisys which showed that it still takes six days for the average shipment to arrive at its destination - the same time as 25 years ago.
It also shows that an average shipment is hhandled 36 times and it took a total of 16 individual documents to ccomplete transhipment.
